description: This file defines the interface and data structures for serial port (tty) support in Zephyr OS, including initialization, buffer management, and read/write operations.

methods.name: tty_init
methods.description: Initializes the tty serial device with the specified UART device.

methods.name: tty_set_rx_timeout
methods.description: Sets the receive timeout for the tty device.

methods.name: tty_set_tx_timeout
methods.description: Sets the transmit timeout for the tty device.

methods.name: tty_set_rx_buf
methods.description: Configures the receive buffer for the tty device.

methods.name: tty_set_tx_buf
methods.description: Configures the transmit buffer for the tty device.

methods.name: tty_read
methods.description: Reads data from the tty device.

methods.name: tty_write
methods.description: Writes data to the tty device.
